name: Automatic Certificate Issuance Failed
description:
Certificate issuance or renewal hit a permanent error, or stopped after repeated
failures. It will not be retried until the underlying problem is resolved and
issuance is retried from the Certificates page.
action: Navigate to the Certificates page and check the error message in the certificate status. Once addressed, invoke the Retry action to retry issuance.

name: Automatic Certificate Renewal Not Progressing
description:
Renewal is being retried and is still failing well past the renewal window.
Usually a DNS delegation or domain validation problem that must be resolved
before issuance can succeed.
action: Navigate to the Certificates page and check the error message in the certificate status. Once addressed, invoke the Retry action to retry issuance.

name: Automatic Certificate Renewal Overdue
description:
The certificate is still valid but past the point at which it should have
renewed, and no renewal attempt is in progress. If left unresolved it will
expire.
action: Navigate to the Certificates page and check the error message in the certificate status. Once addressed, invoke the Retry action to retry issuance.

name: Database Error

action: Check disk performance using collect-database-stats command (Tools -> Site CLI). If 99th percentile latency exceeds 10 seconds, consider using a faster disk. Contact support for further troubleshooting.

name: Database Error
description: The etcd cluster has lost quorum - more than half of the database nodes are unavailable, indicating instability in the cluster.
action:
For CE site with single node: This alert may fire during normal restarts.
For CE sites with multiple nodes, check for active alerts "Intra-cluster connectivity check (Node-To-Node)" or "VesVpmIntraClusterNodeToNodeFailed". If connectivity between nodes is impacted, verify L3 reachability and validate routing correctness across all nodes before engaging support.

name: Database Error

action: For CE sites with multiple nodes, check for active alerts "Intra-cluster connectivity check (Node-To-Node)" or "VesVpmIntraClusterNodeToNodeFailed". If connectivity between nodes is impacted, verify L3 reachability and validate routing correctness across all nodes before engaging support.

name: Database Error

For CE sites with multiple nodes, check for active alerts "Intra-cluster connectivity check (Node-To-Node)" or "VesVpmIntraClusterNodeToNodeFailed". If connectivity between nodes is impacted, verify L3 reachability and validate routing correctness across all nodes before engaging support.
Check disk performance using collect-database-stats command (Tools -> Site CLI). If 99th percentile latency exceeds 10 seconds, consider using a faster disk. Contact support for further troubleshooting.

name: K8S Pod Crashing
description: Pod container is crashing. Check the reason for pod crash.
action:
Service is crashing. Very often reason can be low memory limits. Check why pod is crashing
and if problem persist for more than 15 minutes or continuously crashing and it affects
other services, escalate to L2. If reason is *oomkill*, raise resource limits. If *error*,
contact service's team. If it's a scheduling problem, contact SRE team.

name: K8S Pod Crashing
description: Kubernetes Pod container restarting often. Possible causes can be out of memory limit (OOM), liveness probe or container entrypoint failure.
action: Check Kubernetes Pod status, events and logs in K8s cluster. Contact support in case of non K8s Deployment.

name: K8S Pod Crashing
description: Pod container is crashing. Check the reason for pod crash.
action:
Service is crashing. Very often reason can be low memory limits. Check why pod is crashing
and if problem persist for more than 15 minutes or continuously crashing and it affects
other services, escalate to L2. If reason is *oomkill*, raise resource limits. If *error*,
contact service's team. If it's a scheduling problem, contact SRE team.

For vk8s control-plane pods in namespace `ves-vk8s`, if the crashing container is `drogon`
or `rhaegal` and the reason is OOMKilled, update the corresponding `vulpix.cluster` object
so the change persists after GC upgrades and future reconciliations.

Update these 5 fields:
- `drogon_memory_limit = <overridden_value_for_drogon>`
- `rhaegal_memory_limit = <overridden_value_for_rhaegal>`
- `drogon_memory_limit_sre_overridden = <overridden_value_for_drogon>`
- `rhaegal_memory_limit_sre_overridden = <overridden_value_for_rhaegal>`
- `effective_memory_limit_source = "sre_override"`
